text: uh also here is a bug i found immediately: i dragged a uv to a blank space, then i went and painted the actual mesh, nothing shows up
resolution: Fixed painting after a UV is moved onto transparent atlas space. Face opacity is now retained independently of sampled atlas pixels; brush, fill, material, and polygon paint establish that authored opacity on newly painted texels, so alpha-zero destinations become visible while glass faces keep their glass alpha. Added a native regression covering brush and fill over a transparent destination; all 34 model-paint tests pass.
